from.place: Tag 0AVW case (1): affine Hom-out-of-perfect base change

title: Affine base change for Hom out of a perfect complex
statement: Consider a cartesian square of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes X'=X\times_S S' with g_X:X'\to X, f:X\to S, and g:S'\to S [def-pc-fibre-product], where S=\operatorname{Spec}(R) and S'=\operatorname{Spec}(R') are affine and f and g are Tor independent, meaning that for all x\in X and s'\in S' with the same image s\in S one has \operatorname{Tor}_i^{\mathcal O_{S,s}}(\mathcal O_{X,x},\mathcal O_{S',s'})=0 for all i>0. If M is a perfect complex on X [def-pc-perfect-complex] and K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) [def-pc-derived-category], then the canonical comparison $$R\operatorname{Hom}_X(M,K)\mathbin{\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}}R'\longrightarrow R\operatorname{Hom}_{X'}(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*K)$$ in D(R') is an isomorphism. Here global R\operatorname{Hom} is the derived global Hom complex of [def-pc-global-derived-rhom], and the comparison is induced by derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback].

proof.text: Put M^\vee=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,\mathcal O_X). The perfect tensor-Hom comparison [lem-pc-perfect-rhom-tensor-comparison] identifies M^\vee\otimes^L K with R\mathcal Hom_X(M,K), naturally in K; M^\vee is perfect, hence in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X), so M^\vee\otimes^L K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) by [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-qcoh], and Rf_*(M^\vee\otimes^L K)\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(S) by [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh] since f is qcqs. By [def-pc-global-derived-rhom], R\operatorname{Hom}_X(M,K)=R\Gamma(X,R\mathcal Hom_X(M,K)) with R\Gamma(X,-)=Rp_* for p:X\to(\{\mathrm{pt}\},\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)); viewed in D(R) by restriction along R\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X), p factors as X\xrightarrow{f}S\to(\{\mathrm{pt}\},R), so [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition] gives R\operatorname{Hom}_X(M,K)\cong R\Gamma(S,Rf_*(M^\vee\otimes^L K)) in D(R), and by the affine derived equivalence [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] Rf_*(M^\vee\otimes^L K)\cong\widetilde{R\operatorname{Hom}_X(M,K)}. The same holds on X' over S'=\operatorname{Spec}(R') for Lg_X^*M, Lg_X^*K.

source.place: Tag 0AVW proof, rewrite Hom from a perfect complex using its dual

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-tor-independent-perfect-tensor-base-change] with P=M^\vee and the given K. Its Tor-independence hypotheses are exactly those in the present square, and M^\vee is perfect by the cited perfect tensor-Hom comparison. We obtain an isomorphism from the pullback of Rf_*(M^\vee\otimes^L K) to Rf'_* (Lg_X^*M^\vee\otimes^L Lg_X^*K).

The base-change isomorphism for the perfect dual [lem-pc-perfect-rhom-tensor-comparison] gives Lg_X^*M^\vee\cong R\mathcal Hom_{X'}(Lg_X^*M,\mathcal O_{X'}). Applying the same tensor-Hom comparison on X' identifies Lg_X^*M^\vee\otimes^L Lg_X^*K with R\mathcal Hom_{X'}(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*K). Thus the isomorphism of Step 2 is the canonical comparison after the Hom identifications of Step 1.

source.place: Tag 0AVW proof, compatibility of the dual with pullback

proof.text: Because S and S' are affine, Step 1 writes Rf_*(M^\vee\otimes^L K)\cong\widetilde{R\operatorname{Hom}_X(M,K)} on S and Rf'_*(Lg_X^*M^\vee\otimes^L Lg_X^*K)\cong\widetilde{R\operatorname{Hom}_{X'}(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*K)} on S' [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence]. For g:\operatorname{Spec}(R')\to\operatorname{Spec}(R), clause (2) of [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde] gives Lg^*\widetilde{N}\cong\widetilde{N\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R'} for complexes N of R-modules. Applying R\Gamma(S',-) (the quasi-inverse) to the isomorphism of Steps 2 and 3, the isomorphism obtained is precisely the displayed map R\operatorname{Hom}_X(M,K)\otimes_R^L R'\to R\operatorname{Hom}_{X'}(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*K) in D(R').
